Creates a near-term event; holders of record then may receive contingent payments if milestones occur.
Potential future payout could affect valuation and trading around the record date.
If the Return of Capital Proposal fails, CVRs may not be distributed; vote is a key catalyst.
T+2 settlement risk; buyers on Nov 5 not expected to be record holders.
New shares from in-the-money option surrenders won’t get CVRs, limiting dilution of CVR pool.
